Home.title: Vibrant Auction Marketplace
Home.subtitle: Bangladesh's first trust-focused peer-to-peer auction marketplace. Sell your used goods for quick cash, bid on authentic items, and trade safely via secure mobile advance payments.
Home.heroTitle: Sell What You Don't Use. Bid on What You Love.
Home.heroSubtitle: Bangladesh's first trust-focused peer-to-peer auction marketplace. List pre-loved items in seconds, place live bids in real-time, and trade with absolute confidence using secure mobile advance payments.

Home.step1Desc: Snap a photo of your pre-loved phone, bike, or gear, and list it in 60 seconds with ৳0 listing fees.
Home.step2Desc: Participate in transparent auctions with anti-sniping protection and real-time live bidding updates.
Home.step3Desc: Coordinate local handovers (e.g. Dhanmondi, Gulshan) or home shipping via our secure bKash/Nagad advance-payment holding.
Home.trustSubtitle: We have engineered direct safeguards so you can trade second-hand items without anxiety.
Home.trust1Desc: No corporate subscriptions or hidden costs. It is entirely free to list your goods and place bids.
Home.trust2Desc: Commitment advances are held securely by Nilamit, safeguarding both buyers and sellers from anonymous shill-bids and no-shows.
Home.trust3Desc: Filter auctions by specific neighborhoods to inspect items in person, or arrange secure, verified courier shipping.
Home.trust4Desc: Trade with peace of mind. Every member carries transparent community feedback, completed trade counts, and verified ratings.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Nilamit.
FAQ.a1: Every bid is recorded in real-time. If someone bids in the last 2 minutes, the auction is extended by another 2 minutes to prevent 'sniping'.
FAQ.a2: It is a small commitment fee (logistic insurance) held by the platform to protect both parties. It is unlocked for the seller once the deal is complete.
FAQ.a3: Yes. Your contact information (email/address) is shielded and only revealed to your counter-party after the advance payment is confirmed.

Safety.title: Safety & Integrity
Safety.subtitle: Trusted commerce in Bangladesh.
Safety.shieldDesc: We prioritize verified identities. Sellers with high trust scores are prioritized, and all logistics are gated by financial commitments.
Safety.warningDesc: For your safety, never share your personal email, phone number, or payment details outside this trade chat. Nilamit staff will never ask for your password or OTP.
Safety.heroDesc: Every transaction on Nilamit is backed by our trade-first safety protocol.
Safety.escrowDesc: Your payment is held by Nilamit until you confirm the item arrived as described. If something goes wrong, raise a dispute and we mediate.
Safety.identityDesc: Every user on Nilamit must verify their email address. We use a reputation-based trust model to ensure only serious bidders and sellers interact.
Safety.coordDesc: All buyer-seller communication happens inside the platform after the advance payment is made. Off-platform contact is a red flag — keep it on Nilamit.
Safety.disputeDesc: If a delivery is delayed past 72 hours or the item doesn't match its description, our moderators step in within one business day.

HowItWorks.title: Bidding, Built for Trust.
HowItWorks.subtitle: Nilamit (nilamit.com) isn't just a marketplace—it's a verifiable coordinate system for Bangladeshi commerce. Here is how we protect your deals.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Join our community of trusted traders with a simple email verification.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Bid on premium items with real-time updates and anti-snipe protection.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Winning triggers a secure payment gate. Link your bKash or Nagad to pay the official treasury instantly.
HowItWorks.step4Desc: Once the advance payment is processed, direct buyer-seller chat unlocks to arrange delivery. Both parties are now protected under our hybrid advance-payment agreement.
HowItWorks.ctaDesc: Join thousands of verified traders. Whether you are selling tech gear or buying a collection piece, nilamit ensures the transaction is zero-technicality and full-transparency.
HowItWorks.shieldDesc: Our anti-sniping protection ensures no one "steals" a deal in the last fraction of a second. Every participant gets a fair chance to place their final bid.
